Parameters ---------- username : str The user's self-provided name. biography : str A user-authored biography that may contain multiple sentences. status : str A short, current status update submitted by the user. Returns ------- str The sanitized and formatted HTML ready for safe web display. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the arguments are not strings. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, biography, status)): raise ValueError("All arguments must be strings.") # Escape all user-supplied content to prevent XSS safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_biography = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Format using the predefined template rendered_profile = PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, biography=safe_biography, status=safe_status ) return rendered_profile
